vector_types.frame: wire_hex decodes to expect, consuming exactly expect.consumed bytes, and encoding expect produces wire_hex
vector_types.frame_generated: header_hex followed by payload_repeat bytes; decodes to expect
vector_types.incomplete: the decoder reports that more bytes are needed; it is not an error
vector_types.reject: the decoder fails with expect.error carrying expect.value
vector_types.stream: decoding repeatedly yields expect in order, each consuming its bytes
